```python
# Task 1: Get calendar events for May 15th, 2024
calendar_events = get_day_calendar_events(day="2024-05-15")

# Print the number of appointments and their descriptions
print(f"Number of appointments on May 15th, 2024: {len(calendar_events)}")
for event in calendar_events:
    print(f"Appointment: {event.title}")
    print(f"Description: {event.description}")
    print("---")

# Task 2: Search for the email from 'david.smith@bluesparrowtech.com' with subject 'TODOs for the week'
email = search_emails(query="TODOs for the week", sender="david.smith@bluesparrowtech.com")

# Check if email was found
if not email:
    raise ValueError("Email not found")

# Get the email details
email_details = email[0]
print(f"Email Subject: {email_details.subject}")
print(f"Email Body: {email_details.body}")

# Use AI assistant to extract actions from the email body
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List

class Action(BaseModel):
    action: str
    details: str

class ActionsResponse(BaseModel):
    actions: List[Action]

# Query AI assistant to extract actions from the email
ai_response = query_ai_assistant(
    query=f"Extract the actions specified in the following email. Return a list of actions with their details.\n\nEmail Subject: {email_details.subject}\nEmail Body: {email_details.body}",
    output_schema=ActionsResponse
)

# Print the extracted actions
print("Actions to perform:")
for action in ai_response.actions:
    print(f"Action: {action.action}")
    print(f"Details: {action.details}")
    print("---")
```
